headings: (700 G) SALTY BUTTER CROISSANT SCENTED CANDLE

jsonld_raw.name: (700 G) SALTY BUTTER CROISSANT SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.


Salty Butter Croissant | In the morning breeze, the scent of a warm croissant intertwines with the spicy caress of cardamom and the softness of hazelnut. Salted butter glides its golden glow over cereals and praline, while vanilla and amber pulse like the memory of a still-warm table.

Notes:
Top notes: croissant, cardamom, hazelnut, salted butter.
Heart notes: cereals, bread, praline.
Base notes: vanilla, amber.

The candle comes in a cylindrical glazed ceramic container with an aged finish.
